product_family: Checkmarx One - unified AI-powered application security platform integrating SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container security, API security, and runtime security with agentic AI assistance.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: We're certified to the latest and most recognized global standard for information security

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Checkmarx undergoes an independent SOC 2 Type II audit annually

certifications.name: FedRAMP (Moderate Level, Government variant)
certifications.proof_quote: Checkmarx One for Government (CXG) achieved FedRAMP Certification on 6/12/2026 at Class C (Moderate) level. In September 2025, achieved FedRAMP Ready at the High Impact Level.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Our privacy program aligns with the stringent requirements of GDPR

certifications.name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
certifications.proof_quote: We align with the NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) to integrate security at every stage

certifications.name: ACN Level 2 (Italy - Agenzia per la Cybersicurezza Nazionale)
certifications.proof_quote: Checkmarx One achieves ACN Level 2 certification from Italy's National Cybersecurity Agency, confirming adherence to highest standards for cybersecurity, governance, and risk management

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification. Checkmarx offers HIPAA compliance mapping and presets to help customers achieve HIPAA compliance, but does not hold HIPAA certification for its own product.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification. Checkmarx offers PCI DSS compliance mapping and presets to help customers achieve PCI DSS compliance, but does not hold PCI DSS certification for its own product.

privacy.ai_training_note: Checkmarx explicitly does NOT train AI models on customer code or proprietary data. Source code, secrets, and application data never leave the IDE. Only limited metadata (package name, version, manager, vulnerability IDs) is transmitted for enrichment. Customer code remains protected.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region SaaS with instances in North America, EU, Australia, India, and Singapore. Daily backups retain for 7 days, stored in different AWS regions per customer request.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 with pre-signed, time-limited URLs for data uploads

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: All customer data encrypted at rest in AWS S3 storage

security.name: Data backups
security.value: Daily backups of all customer data, retained for 7 days, stored in secure locations and separate AWS regions

security.name: Access control
security.value: Dedicated and encrypted S3 storage paths, accessible only to customer and authorized authenticated users

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: All actions in AWS environment logged via CloudTrail, encrypted and stored centrally for audit and compliance purposes

products.name: Checkmarx One
products.data_scope: Source code, dependencies, containers, runtime behavior, AI components, secrets, IaC configurations, APIs
products.notes: Unified platform integrating SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets detection, IaC, container, API security, runtime security, and agentic AI assistance. Multi-tenant SaaS with dedicated customer data storage. Standard version targets commercial markets; Checkmarx One for Government (CXG) variant available with FedRAMP Moderate certification.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription with usage-based or per-instance pricing; private hosting options available
compare.data_residency: Multi-region SaaS (North America, EU, Australia, India, Singapore) with per-customer AWS region selection for backups

flags: The homepage claims 'FedRAMP Authorized', but the FedRAMP certification (Moderate level) applies only to the Checkmarx One for Government (CXG) product, not the standard Checkmarx One platform. This is technically accurate but could mislead buyers of the standard product.
The government variant (CXG) has a separate FedRAMP authorization path from standard Checkmarx One; buyers should confirm which product holds which certification before purchasing.

Checkmarx offers HIPAA and PCI DSS compliance presets and mapping, but does not hold HIPAA or PCI DSS certifications itself. Marketing materials that mention 'HIPAA compliance' may conflate product features with vendor certifications.
